show: 1929. A shoeshine boy gave Joe Kennedy a stock tip.
say: In nineteen twenty-nine, a shoeshine boy gave Joe Kennedy a stock tip.

show: Kennedy went home... and sold everything.
say: Kennedy went home... and sold everything.

show: The story goes, he thought: if the shoeshine boy has tips, everyone's already in.
say: The story goes, he thought: if the shoeshine boy has tips, everyone's already in.

show: He kept his fortune. Millions didn't.
say: He kept his fortune. Millions didn't.

show: Kennedy didn't have better tips. He had rules.
say: Kennedy didn't have better tips. He had rules.

show: Every week, we teach those rules in a free live class.
say: Every week, we teach those rules in a free live class.
